notes:
• New Sound choice in the player (Audio & Subtitles › Sound, Speed & Sync): Original, Dialogue boost (clearer voices on TV speakers) or Night mode (loud scenes down, quiet talking up). Remembered on each device
• Dialogue boost and Night mode play in stereo and decode the audio in ValFlix, so a soundbar gets plain sound instead of Dolby while they're on; Original works as before
• The player's Info panel shows which Sound choice is on
